Through hands-on experience researching and valuing crypto protocols, I’ve developed a deep understanding of tokenomics, on-chain financial modeling, and valuation multiples-particularly how narrative, utility, and macro cycles influence protocol value.

I’ve executed investment theses across DeFi, AI-based crypto infrastructure, and BTC-native credit markets, combining both qualitative research and quantitative frameworks. I’ve also completed Wall Street Prep and Bloomberg Market Concepts, sharpening my technical skills in financial modeling, DCFs, and comp analysis-tools I actively apply to both equities and on-chain assets.

Earlier in my journey, I cut my teeth in door-to-door solar sales, where I generated $150K+ in revenue. That experience instilled in me grit, communication finesse, and a results-oriented mindset that I bring into every project-whether I’m pitching a fund thesis, modeling a deal, or breaking down liquidity data on-chain.

Now, I’m focused on bridging the gap between institutional finance and blockchain capital markets, while preparing for a career in investment banking, equity research, or venture capital.

originalDataLookup.fullSummary:
Ready to invest in Miami with a real edge—before prices climb even higher?

I’m Juan Pablo Rubio, a pre-construction specialist helping Spanish and Latin American investors navigate Miami’s real estate market.

With over 15 years of continuously tracking Miami’s real estate trends, projects, and opportunities, I relocated here permanently in 2022 to be on the ground and capture the strongest phases of the current cycle.

I bring more than 20 years of experience in the sector. In Madrid I led new-development departments for major brokerages and developers, overseeing the full project lifecycle: land acquisition, feasibility studies, architectural concepts, unit typologies, pricing strategies, and multimillion-dollar sales campaigns. I coordinated premium design teams (interiors, landscaping, lighting) to maximize value and profitability in high-end residential projects.

Now based in Miami, I put that same strategic vision, deep local market knowledge, and ability to see beyond the obvious at the service of investors like you:

-Early access to the most sought-after projects (branded residences, ultra-luxury amenities)
-Launch pricing + maximum capital appreciation potential
-Fully customized strategy: smart project selection, profitability analysis, legal & financing coordination, post-purchase management

Everything in your language—no cultural barriers, no surprises

I help protect and grow dollar-denominated capital, diversify portfolios, and generate strong rental income (including short-term rentals).

If you’re ready to enter the most dynamic U.S. market intelligently and without unnecessary risk, just message me what you’re looking for (residential, commercial, STR, branded residences…). I’ll personally reply with real, up-to-date 2026 pre-construction opportunities.

Let’s connect and grow your investment together!

#MiamiPreConstruction #MiamiInvestment #MiamiRealEstate #LatinAmericanInvestors #SpanishInvestorsMiami

Her leadership contributes to the company’s reputation as a leader in luxury real estate services. 

Melissa’s expertise bridges creative strategy and tactical execution, ensuring cohesive communication across digital platforms, internal teams, and global audiences. Her work supports thousands of real estate professionals in delivering best-in-class experiences to clients locally and internationally. 

Based in Naples, Florida, Melissa brings a blend of strategic insight, operational rigor, and passion for the real estate industry to every initiative — helping to uphold and advance the esteemed Sotheby’s International Realty brand in competitive markets.
